tooltips.hideHUDTip: Hide the recording bar. Show it again from the tray icon.
tooltips.restartRecording: Delete this recording and start a new one
tooltips.systemAudio: System audio: records the sound your computer plays
tooltips.camera: Camera: records you as a separate layer you can move in the editor

notesToolbar.mirrorTip: Flip the text left to right, to read it in a mirror

cursor.name: Editable cursor
cursor.editableTip: Editable cursor: recorded separately, so you can restyle it and auto-zoom in the editor
cursor.systemTip: System cursor: your real cursor, recorded in the video. No restyling, no auto-zoom.

keys.name: Key capture
keys.onTip: Keys are saved with the take, so the editor can show them. Click to turn off.
keys.offTip: Keys are not saved. Click to turn on.
keys.onRecordingTip: Saving keys. Click to pause, for example to type a password.
keys.pausedTip: Paused: keys are not saved. Click to resume.
keys.offRecordingTip: Keys are not saved in this take.

sourceSelector.emptyDescription: If you just granted screen recording permission, reload this picker. On macOS you may need to reopen Filmareto.
sourceSelector.loadFailedDescription: Filmareto couldn't load your screens and windows. Reload this picker and try again.

recording.selectSource: Choose a screen or window to record
recording.systemPicker: Your system will ask what to share
recording.noMicrophone: The microphone is off: this take will have no sound.

systemLanguagePrompt.title: Use your system language?
systemLanguagePrompt.description: We detected {{language}} as your system language. Do you want to switch Filmareto to {{language}}?

softwareEncoderFallback.title: Switched to a backup encoder
softwareEncoderFallback.description: Your graphics card's encoder didn't start, so Filmareto switched to a backup. Your recording is fine, though your computer may work a little harder.

permissions.title: Filmareto needs a few permissions
permissions.subtitle: macOS asks you to grant each one once. You can change them at any time in System Settings.

screen.name: Screen & system audio
screen.description: To record your screen and the sound your Mac plays.

systemAudio.name: System audio
systemAudio.description: To record the sound your Mac plays. Choosing a screen or window needs no permission.

accessibility.name: Accessibility
accessibility.description: To show the right cursor (pointer, text) in your recordings.

camera.name: Camera
camera.description: To add your webcam to your recordings.

help.screenPrompt: macOS will then ask you to turn on Filmareto in System Settings.
help.screenSettings: In System Settings, turn on Filmareto. If macOS offers to quit and reopen it, accept: this window will come back.
help.screenNotListed: Filmareto isn't in the list? Click +, then choose Filmareto in Applications.
help.screenRestart: Allowed. Filmareto needs to restart before it can use it.
help.screenRecurring: On your first recording, macOS will ask whether Filmareto may access your screen directly, without the system picker. Click Allow. macOS asks again from time to time; that's expected.
help.systemAudioPrompt: macOS will ask you to allow Filmareto to record the sound your Mac plays.
help.systemAudioRequested: If you said no, turn on Filmareto under “System Audio Recording Only” in System Settings.

footer.screenRequired: Screen recording is needed to record.

scene.cameraOnlyOn: Records only the camera and the microphone
scene.cameraOnlyOff: Record only the camera, no screen
scene.retrySegment: This segment again from the start
scene.bulletsHint: Each line of the script is a bullet. Step through them with the next line control.
scene.recHides: Rec hides this window and starts the teleprompter.
scene.shortcutHint: Click a shortcut, then press the new keys. Esc cancels, Backspace clears.
scene.cameraNeeded: Turn the camera on in the recording bar to see it here
scene.helperErrorFile: The audio file couldn't be opened
scene.helperErrorOther: The teleprompter helper reported a problem
